feature_toggle_meaning.signal: Disables explicit signal and type-signal feature columns and E2 signal subgroup; A2 priors remain signal-conditioned by definition.
feature_toggle_meaning.half_life_grid: Changes the per-machine holdout-selected baseline memory grid; multihalf-life summary channels remain16/128.
feature_toggle_meaning.pairs: Removes selected pair-product channels and pair regressors in per-machine baseline.
feature_toggle_meaning.density: Changes history frequency and per-machine ridge fit weights using inferred recent/older observation-density ratio.

reproduce.common: From repository root with PYTHONPATH=docs/sai: exec JSON source W3W4_COMMON.json; load_features() regenerates the intermediate cache once. HE_SHARED_CACHE can redirect the lead cache for a new round; required W1 train screen filename is matched to train n/sum-of-payouts fingerprint.
reproduce.W3: Run from repository root with PYTHONPATH=docs/sai; execute source in W3_IMPLEMENTATION.json with argv [driver, E1..E5, smoke|full].
reproduce.W4: Run from docs/sai with PYTHONPATH=.; execute source in W4_IMPLEMENTATION.json with argv [driver, S1..S8, smoke|full]. Defaults reproduce selected HistGB20 and MLP200. Set W4_HIST_ITER=80 or W4_MLP_ITER=35 to reproduce extra iteration variants.
reproduce.S5_NESTED: Source and fixed selected params retained in S5_NESTED.json; audit truth never used.

harness_limitations: Single-condition evaluate/diff_ci yields undefined values because scorer averages four conditions; condition CIs therefore use a full-dev hybrid replacement. Harness was not modified.

S5 original stack check is not nested; use separate S5_NESTED fixed-selected-hyper diagnostic.
